results.releaseNotes:
Aether Synth 1.20 — Redesigned for iPhone Duo

Introducing iPhone Duo Support!

Aether Synth expands into a new dimension with an adaptive experience designed for iPhone Duo.

Move between the compact outer display and the expansive inner screen, giving you more room to explore, shape, and perform your sound.

What's New:
- iPhone Duo Support — A redesigned, adaptive interface that takes advantage of both displays.
- More Room to Create — Expanded workspaces bring synthesis, sequencing, and performance controls together on the larger display.
- Flexible Layouts — The interface adapts to different screen sizes and folding configurations.
- Refined Experience — Interface improvements and optimizations across supported devices.

From pocket-sized inspiration to an expansive creative workspace, Aether Synth is built to make music wherever inspiration strikes.

One synth. More possibilities.
results.description:
Aether Synth is an AUv3 synthesizer, sequencer and sampler for iPhone Duo, iPhone and iPad, built for creating expressive sounds that move.

Start with a sound, combine two sounds into something new, introduce motion, build a pattern, capture a sample, or simply play. Aether brings synthesis, sequencing, sampling and performance together in one instrument designed to keep ideas moving.

CREATE YOUR OWN SOUND

Build rich synth patches for pads, basses, leads, textures, atmospheres and evolving sounds.

Aether is designed to make sound creation immediate. Shape a patch directly, explore presets for inspiration, or use Random Sound to discover combinations you might not have reached manually.

The result can become a finished sound or the starting point for something completely different.

DUAL — TWO SOUNDS BECOME ONE

Dual lets you combine two independent sounds into a new composite instrument.

Choose a sound for A.
Choose another for B.
Blend between them and shape the result.

The two sides can complement each other, contrast with each other, or create something that neither patch produces alone.

Save your favorite Blends and return to them later.

MAKE SOUNDS MOVE

Aether is built around motion as part of the instrument.

Use Motion and Random Motion to animate sound over time and create patches that evolve rather than remain static.

Movement can be subtle and organic or become a major rhythmic part of the sound.

This makes Aether especially suited to evolving pads, shifting textures, rhythmic sounds and patches that respond like performances rather than snapshots.

SEQUENCE IDEAS

Turn sounds into patterns with Aether's built-in sequencer.

Create melodic and rhythmic phrases, experiment with different rates and musical feels, and develop ideas without leaving the instrument.

The arpeggiator provides another immediate way to transform held notes and chords into movement, while tempo synchronization keeps rhythmic material locked to the music.

SAMPLING

Capture and work with audio directly inside Aether.

Use sampling alongside synthesis to bring recorded material into the same creative environment as your patches, patterns and performances.

A sample can become part of a larger musical idea instead of living in a separate workflow.

PERFORM

Aether is designed to be played.

Use the keyboard and performance controls to shape sounds in real time, then connect a MIDI controller when you want a more traditional playing experience.

Velocity, sustain and expressive controls allow patches to respond dynamically instead of behaving like static presets.

DISCOVER INSTEAD OF SEARCHING

Sometimes you know exactly what sound you want.

Sometimes you don't.

Random Sound and Random Motion make exploration part of the workflow. Generate a new direction, keep what works, reshape it, combine it with another sound in Dual, and continue from there.

The goal is not randomness for its own sake. It is getting from a blank idea to something musically useful quickly.

STANDALONE OR AUV3

Use Aether as a standalone instrument on iPhone and iPad, or load it as an AUv3 instrument inside compatible hosts and DAWs.

That means the same sound-design environment can work as an instrument on its own or become part of a larger mobile production setup.

BUILT FOR MUSICIANS

Aether brings together:

• Synthesizer sound design
• Dual layered instruments and saved Blends
• Motion and evolving sound
• Random Sound and Random Motion
• Preset exploration
• Sequencing
• Arpeggiation
• Sampling
• Performance controls
• MIDI
• Standalone operation
• AUv3 plugin support

Whether you're designing an evolving ambient texture, building a bass or lead, creating a rhythmic patch, experimenting with layered sounds, or starting a new musical idea from scratch, Aether is designed to keep the distance between inspiration and sound as short as possible.

Create a sound.
Make it move.
Turn it into music.
